name: codico
description: Reliability-first autonomous VS Code coding agent with native tools, resilient streaming, multi-provider support, optional ACCO optimization, browser/MCP automation, and local Ollama.

codico.model.description: Model ID to use. Use an OpenRouter model ID (e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash) or prefix with ollama/ to use a local Ollama model (e.g. ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b).

codico.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the local Ollama server. Change this if Ollama is running on a non-default port or remote host.

codico.autoInjectContext.description: Automatically include the active file path and selection as context in each message

codico.maxIterations.description: Maximum normal agentic loop iterations before stopping (0 = no limit). Bounded mutation/verification grace may extend a capped coding task without reopening exploration.

codico.verificationGraceIterations.description: Extra iterations allowed only when maxIterations is reached while a code edit is still awaiting acceptance verification. Pure exploration never receives this grace.

codico.mutationGraceIterations.description: Extra iterations allowed only when maxIterations is reached after an explicit coding task has finished focused source reading but still has no successful mutation. Discovery remains closed during this grace.

codico.checkpointSteps.description: Pause and ask whether to continue every N agent steps (0 = never pause)

codico.taskTokenBudget.description: Pause and ask whether to continue each time a task uses this many more tokens (prompt + completion across all steps). 0 = no budget.

codico.terminalTimeoutSeconds.description: Kill a run_terminal command (and everything it started) after this many seconds

codico.streamStallTimeoutSeconds.description: Treat a model response that sends nothing for this many seconds as a dropped connection and reconnect, instead of waiting forever

codico.nativeToolCalling.description: Use provider-native function/tool calling when supported. Disable to force compatibility fenced tools.

codico.browserAllowPrivateNetwork.description: Allow Codico browser automation to access localhost, private, link-local, and internal network destinations. Disabled by default for SSRF safety.

codico.inlineCompletionsEnabled.description: Enable ghost-text inline completions as you type

codico.inlineCompletionsDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in ms before requesting an inline completion

codico.openTabsContext.description: Include open editor tabs as additional context when sending messages

codico.globalHistory.description: Persist conversation history across all workspaces (global) instead of per-workspace

codico.embeddingModel.description: OpenRouter model ID used to generate embeddings for semantic workspace search. Must support the /v1/embeddings endpoint.

codico.autoIndex.description: Automatically build the workspace semantic index after you explicitly enable this setting. Cloud embeddings send code chunks to OpenRouter.

codico.nextEditSuggestionsEnabled.description: Show AI-predicted next edit suggestions (Tab to accept) after you make a change

codico.renameSuggestionsEnabled.description: Pre-fill the rename input (F2) with an AI-suggested identifier name

codico.symbolContextEnabled.description: Automatically include LSP symbol info (type, definition, references) for the symbol under cursor as context

codico.followUpSuggestionsEnabled.description: Show 2-3 suggested follow-up questions after each AI response

codico.responseSummaryEnabled.description: Append a Summary and Conclusion block at the end of each AI response, before follow-up suggestions

codico.autoInjectDiagnostics.description: Automatically include all workspace Problems panel errors and warnings in the AI context preamble for every message

codico.completionNotificationsEnabled.description: Show a VS Code notification when the agent finishes a task while the window is not focused

codico.completionNotificationThresholdMs.description: Minimum task duration (milliseconds) before a completion notification is shown

codico.proactiveErrorDetection.description: When you open a file with errors, show an offer in the chat panel to fix them automatically

codico.codeLensEnabled.description: Show Explain / Fix CodeLens actions above function definitions

codico.autoCompactThreshold.description: Prompt token count above which auto-compact triggers (when Auto Compact is enabled in the chat UI)

codico.mcpServers.description: List of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to connect to. Each entry: { name, command, args?, env? }. You can also use a .mcp.json file in the workspace root.

name.description: Unique display name for this MCP server

command.description: Executable to run (e.g. npx, node, python)

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process

codico.accoEnabled.description: Optimize OpenRouter provider-facing request copies through a local ACCO SDK service. Codico's canonical history and agent/verification loop remain unchanged; failures fall back to the original request.

codico.accoBaseUrl.description: Loopback URL of the local ACCO sdk-serve service (for example: acco sdk-serve .). Non-loopback URLs are rejected.

codico.accoTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for local ACCO provider optimization before failing open to the original OpenRouter request.
